vocabmatch.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: to meet new people for your business
a short, easy conversation about simple things
the person who organizes an event and welcomes people
to talk again later, by message or by phone
a big meeting for many people, like a fair or a party
a person you know who can help your business
a person who is invited to an event

listenings.text: Good evening, everyone, and welcome to the Business Aviation Networking Night. My name is Tom, and I am the event manager. Tonight we have three hundred guests from twelve countries. Have you met the people at your table? Please say hello and make a new connection. At eight o'clock, our host, Anna Brooks, will talk about flight schools in Texas. Dinner starts at nine. And please, don't forget your business cards. Enjoy the evening!

Hi, I am Sofia, from Texas. Have you ever been nervous at a networking event? I have! Here are my three tips. First, arrive early. When the room is not full, it is easy to talk. Second, start with small talk. Ask: Have you been here before? Where are you from? Third, listen more than you talk. People remember a good listener. After the event, I always send a short message the next day to keep in touch. Last year, I met two of my best clients at events like this.

extra_audio.text: First, Karina arrives at the networking night in Miami. Then, Mike asks her: Have you met Anna? Next, Mike introduces Karina to Anna, the host. After that, Karina and Anna make small talk about Brazil. Finally, they exchange business cards and keep in touch.
